title: Customer Postal Address
description: A structured physical address. Sub-field names follow the SCIM 2.0 "addresses" complex attribute (RFC 7643 section 4.1.2), which in turn follows the components of vCard "ADR" (RFC 6350 section 6.3.1).

type.description: work, home, other. SCIM sub-attribute "type"; vCard TYPE parameter.

streetAddress.description: Full street address, newlines permitted. SCIM sub-attribute "streetAddress".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. SCIM sub-attribute "country".

formatted.description: The full address as a single presentable string. SCIM sub-attribute "formatted".
